3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:e8ce105e-dd5d.description: Don’t see a specific role that’s a perfect fit for your background or interests? Not a problem! Here at 3Y Health we are always open to onboarding exceptional talent opportunistically. About Us At 3Y Health, we are building AI-driven software to empower healthcare providers and solve the overwhelming administrative complexity that consumes 40% of the industry’s revenue. Our end-to-end platform unlocks opportunities for clinician entrepreneurs, enabling medical professionals to launch, run, and grow private practices. By supporting these independent practices with the latest AI and automation, we’re helping providers reclaim their time, build thriving businesses, and deliver better outcomes for their communities. 3Y Health is backed by over $200M from top-tier investors including Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Softbank, and 8VC. General Application This is a general interest call for exceptional individuals who want to be part of something ambitious. You might be: - A former founder or co-founder who knows what it takes to build from zero. - A technologist, product thinker, or researcher obsessed with AI and LLMs. - A healthcare innovator who’s lived the pain points of legacy systems and sees a better path. - A builder at heart, hungry for velocity, impact, and meaning in your work. You don’t need to fit into a traditional job description—we’re more interested in your trajectory, your curiosity, and your ability to move fast and make sense of complexity. If we think there might be a mutual fit, our team will be in touch!

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:9be18753-6951-405.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Agents
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:9be18753-6951-405.description: About Socratix AI Socratix AI builds AI coworkers for fraud, financial crime, and compliance teams. Our agents investigate every transaction and user around the clock — gathering evidence across core banking activity, check images, device intelligence, and screening hits so every case opens with the full picture, not a dozen tabs. As one of our first engineers, you'll shape the technical foundation of Socratix AI (YC S25). We build AI agents that investigate fraud and financial crime for banks, credit unions, and leading fintechs — agents that reason through real cases, gather evidence across systems, and produce decisions that stand up to regulators. You'll design and ship production AI agents that fraud and compliance teams rely on every day, collaborate directly with founders on product strategy, and partner with both large enterprises and cutting-edge fintechs. This is a high-impact role with massive scope for growth — you won't just be building features, you'll be defining how agentic AI transforms financial crime operations. Our Culture: F.O.R.C.E. We believe the right culture builds unstoppable teams. At Socratix, our values spell F.O.R.C.E. — the driving force behind everything we do: - First Principles – We start from truth, not tradition, and solve problems in original ways. - Ownership – What you work on is yours to elevate; we take accountability and act with confidence. - Relentlessness – We finish what we start, turning obstacles into breakthroughs. - Customer First – Every decision is measured by one standard: does this make our customers’ lives easier? - Empathy – We respect differing perspectives, design for human needs, and build trust that lasts. What You’ll Do - Build agents end to end: LLM orchestration, tool use across a growing set of MCP integrations, retrieval, and multi-agent workflows that automate real investigations. - Own the layer that makes agents trustworthy — eval harnesses, guardrails, audit trails, human-in-the-loop review. When your agent decides, a bank acts on it. - Ship fast and close to users: code in prod your first week, direct customer contact, your work catching actual fraud. Design and deliver production-grade AI agents. - Experiment relentlessly. New models, new techniques, new tooling — you'll have license to try everything and keep what wins. - Turn frontier into product. You'll spend real time probing what the newest models can do, then ship the parts that survive contact with real fraud cases - Shape roadmap and strategy with the founders. Small team, zero bureaucracy, maximum ownership. What We’re Looking For - A systems thinker. You reason about the whole machine — data flow, failure modes, latency, cost, what breaks at 10x — not just the function you're writing. Agents are distributed systems with a nondeterministic component in the middle; if that framing excites you, keep reading. - You've shipped real things with LLMs — production systems, prototypes with users, obsessive side projects. - Deep engineering fundamentals. Frameworks are details you pick up in a weekend (we're mostly Python on AWS). What matters is that you can design, ship, debug, and operate a production system end to end. - 0 → 1 builder. Ambiguity and speed energize you instead of stressing you out. - Roughly 2–4 years of engineering experience — or a portfolio that makes that line irrelevant. - Prior experience in startups is a plus - Curiosity about fintech, fraud, or building AI where the stakes are real and regulated. Benefits We believe in generous, top-tier compensation and benefits: - Competitive salary and equity benchmarked to top tech companies. - Paid meals during workdays. - 100% health, dental, and vision coverage. - Hybrid schedule - in-office 3 days a week. - Commuter Benefits - Unlimited PTO.

southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:0e488c6c-9.title: Founding Revenue & Sales
southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:0e488c6c-9.description: ABOUT TOWN Town is an applied AI company building a powerful assistant that makes it easy for anyone to create and use software in their everyday work. Town starts from who you are — it builds a persistent model of your voice, judgment, relationships, and priorities, and does real work on your behalf across email, calendar, docs, Slack, and CRM. It doesn't wait to be prompted: it observes, learns, and acts. We recently raised a $55M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, Alt Capital, and Conviction. We're in-person in San Francisco's Financial District, five days a week. ABOUT THE ROLE Town is a true product-led-growth company. People find Town, start using it themselves, and tell all their friends and colleagues. This means multiple users routinely sign up from the same company, so we already have enterprises with real usage inside them. What we don't have yet is anyone whose job is to turn that groundswell into lasting enterprise relationships. In one recent case, a ~60-person company bought an enterprise plan after 20 email exchanges... without anyone at Town ever speaking to them. That's the opportunity sitting on the table. Today the GTM motion is handled reactively, and there's far more inbound interest than we can keep up with. It's time for our first dedicated commercial hire to own the whole motion, and to help build the function that keeps turning product love into revenue. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Turn signal into pipeline. Work the demand already flowing in from the product — turn self-serve signups into conversations, and conversations into enterprise deals. No warm account left cold. - Run the full deal cycle. Demos, pricing, negotiation, and close. You own each account from first touch through expansion — the single point of ownership for everything commercial. - Get customers to value. Own onboarding, live trainings, and sector-specific enablement so new customers succeed fast and expand. - Build the playbook. You're first, so you'll define the motion — what converts, what scales, and what the next GTM hires should do. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU... - Are a full-cycle commercial operator. Maybe you've carried a number at a startup and run deals end to end — sourcing, demo, procurement, pricing, close, and expansion. - Have been told that you're a like a Swiss army knife with the versatility you bring. You thrive in roles with that rare blend of commercial instinct, product depth, and relationship skill. You can be the trusted owner of an account, not just a closer, because you love going deep on the product. - Identify as a builder. You're energized by the impact that you get from the scrappy 0-1 phase more than just executing on a repeatable motion. You create pipeline and process from scratch, and you know that the unglamorous side of being at a start-up is sometimes the most important. - Enjoy environments that move quickly where everyone is high agency. You find the work and own the outcome. You decide at 70%, not 90%, and correct as you go. - Get energy from working with people in person. We're 5x per week at our office in SF! LOCATION In-person in San Francisco's Financial District, five days a week.
